## From emuR

reindeer reads and writes the same `_emuDB` directories, so existing corpora
open unchanged. Only the verbs differ.

| emuR | reindeer |
|---|---|
| `load_emuDB()` | `corpus()` |
| `query()` | `query()` then `collect()` (lazy by default) |
| `requery_seq()` | `scout()` |
| `requery_hier()` | `move_to()` |
| `get_trackdata()` | `quantify()` |
| `list_bundles()`, `list_sessions()` | `get_metadata(corp)` (one row per bundle) |
| `import_mediaFiles()` | `import_media()` |
| `serve()` | `annotate()` (opens Artic) |
| `export_TextGridCollection()`, `convert_TextGridCollection()` | `write_annotations()`, `read_annotations()` |

Query results are tibbles with a `segment_list` class, so dplyr verbs work and
record which rows each step dropped (`provenance()`). Measurements adapt to the
speaker's `Age` and `Gender` metadata (`vignette("speaker_aware")`).

## From reindeer 2.x

This section is generated from `NEWS.md`, so it cannot drift from the release
notes.

```{r removed, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
news <- c(system.file("NEWS.md", package = "reindeer"), "../NEWS.md", "NEWS.md")
news <- news[nzchar(news) & file.exists(news)][1]
x <- readLines(news, warn = FALSE)
start <- grep("^## Removed in 3\\.0\\.0", x)
if (length(start)) {
  end <- grep("^#{1,2} ", x)
  end <- min(end[end > start], length(x) + 1L)
  cat(x[(start + 1L):(end - 1L)], sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("See `NEWS.md` for the list of removed names.\n")
}
```
